blurb: Beachwood Golf Club features a traditional golf course designed by Gene Hamm with wide fairways and well-protected greens. The club offers personalized golf lessons from PGA professionals, a full-service driving range with grass and mat hitting areas, and a clubhouse with food and drinks. Snowbird golf memberships and golf packages including multiple courses are available for extended stays.
